metadata.description: The commission amount.
Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
The total commission per trade.
Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.
Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.
